newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Glengarry, Tanami report gold show.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Glengarry, Tanami report gold show.

text.p: Glengarry Resources NL and Tanami Gold NL said on Monday drilling of their Sandpiper/Kookabura East and Hawk mine prospects in Western Australia showed near-surface ore grade gold mineralisation.
The drilling confirmed strong potential for locating gold resources at both prospects, the 50-50 partners said.

Results from a 200-metre drilling programme included 24 metres grading 3.87 grams of gold a tonne (g/t) from 34 meters, including 10 metres at 7.34 g/t at Sandpiper/Kookaburra East, the companies said in a statement.
At the Hawk propsect, 16 metres at 1.79 g/t from six metres was recorded, including nine metres at 2.42 g/t.
An extensive drilling programme is planned for next year, the companies said.
